# Last9

> > Last9 is a managed observability platform for Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and high-cardinality telemetry data with AI-powered insights.

Last9 provides comprehensive monitoring solutions for cloud-native infrastructure, featuring Kubernetes and VictoriaMetrics integrations, PromQL-based alerting, real user monitoring (RUM), and an AI Assistant for conversational observability. The platform helps SRE and DevOps teams manage complex telemetry at scale.

## Key Topics

- Prometheus
- OpenTelemetry
- PromQL
- Kubernetes
- VictoriaMetrics
- High cardinality data
- Observability platform
- Alert rules and anomaly detection
- Real User Monitoring (RUM)
- AI Assistant
- Telemetry data management
- SLOs (Service Level Objectives)
- Application performance monitoring
- Cloud-native monitoring

- [Introduction | Last9 Documentation](https://docs.last9.io): Main documentation hub covering Last9 setup, telemetry, and OpenTelemetry
- [Introduction | Last9 Documentation](https://last9.io/docs): Last9 documentation index covering telemetry, SLOs, and integrations
- [Alert Rules | Last9 Documentation](https://last9.io/docs/alert-rules): Configure alert rules with thresholds and anomaly detection algorithms
- [Configuring an Alert | Last9 Documentation](https://last9.io/docs/configuring-an-alert): Step-by-step guide to configuring alert rules with PromQL indicators
- [Tutorials | Last9 Documentation](https://last9.io/docs/howto): Prometheus, Kubernetes, and VictoriaMetrics monitoring tutorials
- [AI Assistant | Last9 Documentation](https://last9.io/docs/ai-assistant): Conversational observability with AI Assistant in Slack and IDEs via MCP
- [Application Performance | Last9 Documentation](https://last9.io/docs/discover-applications-performance): Monitor Core Web Vitals and application performance with real user data
- [Application Errors | Last9 Documentation](https://last9.io/docs/rum-errors): Monitor JavaScript errors and exceptions with detailed browser breakdowns
